name: kama
description: Syntax highlighting and zero-config debugging for the kama language (.kama). Press F5 in a .kama to build + debug via CodeLLDB.
comment-activationEvents: Deliberately absent. VS Code >= 1.74 GENERATES `onLanguage:kama` from the `contributes.languages` entry below, and `engines.vscode` is ^1.75.0 — spelling it out again is redundant and the extension linter flags it. Opening a .kama is already the activation point the status-bar item needs.

contributes.comment-configuration: Two settings, and neither mirrors the BUILD configuration: that channel is kama.local.json, so the editor and `kama build` cannot disagree and every other editor overrides it the same way. See docs/editors.md.

kama.path.description: Path to the kama compiler. Empty searches the workspace (build/<os>-<arch>/kama, then ./kama) and falls back to PATH. The binary must be native to this OS — a container-built one will not launch.

kama.trace.server.description: Log the JSON-RPC traffic to and from `kama lsp` in the kama Language Server output channel.

comment-devDependencies: Test-only: the TextMate tokenizer behind tools/check-syntax.sh. vsce ships production deps only, so this is not packaged into the .vsix.
